chapter.heading: A Psalm by Asaph.
chapter.v:
God presides
in the great assembly.He judges among the gods.

“How long
will you judge unjustly,and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

“Defend the
weak, the poor, and the fatherless.Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

Rescue the
weak and needy.Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

They don’t
know, neither do they understand.They walk back and forth in darkness.All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

I said,
“You are gods,all of you are sons of the Most High.

Nevertheless you
shall die like men,and fall like one of the rulers.”

Arise, God,
judge the earth,for you inherit all of the nations.
